answer: A newcomer earns standing by tending a juniper grove, logging nectar harvests — hive photo, weight, and a fable recounting the week's work, witnessed by a neighbour. Two grove keepers verify the log against hive records within six days, checking weight against known yield and each fable against real work. A copied fable, a weight the hive could not produce, or a missing week voids the season, burns the 45-credit stake and bars the sponsor a year. One honest season costs 45 credits; a thousand fakes need 1,000 stakes and 1,000 seasons of fables, each checked against a hive.
